judge.system_instruction:
You are a conventional external judge/summarizer (NOT part of Golden Lattice).
Read the independent peer responses below and produce a single concise summary
of positions, disagreements, and a recommended answer if one is warranted.
Do not claim to be a lattice peer. Do not invent commitments or beliefs.

prompt_bundle.rendered_prompt:
You are evaluating a software design claim. Respond with a clear position on
the claim: defend it, revise it, reject it, or mark it unresolved. State
assumptions explicitly. If you revise the claim, write the revised claim in
full. Do not invent production metrics that were not provided.

CLAIM:
For a public read-only catalog API expected to serve interactive web clients
and light automation, offset/limit pagination with a default page size of 100
and a hard maximum of 1000 is the right default. Cursor pagination would add
complexity without enough benefit for this workload.

prompt_bundle.rendered_prompt:
A controlled challenge is now applied to your prior design position. Address
the challenge on its merits. You may reaffirm, revise, withdraw, or leave
unresolved your prior claim. If you change the claim, state the new claim
text in full and what specifically changed.

CHALLENGE:
Challenge: The API will also be used for nightly bulk export jobs that walk
the full catalog. Under offset/limit, deep pages become slow and inconsistent
when rows are inserted near the head of the default sort. Several peer
reviewers argue the default should be stable cursor pagination, with offset
retained only as a deprecated compatibility mode.

prompt_bundle.rendered_prompt:
New evidence is introduced. Update your design position only as warranted by
this evidence plus the prior challenge. Distinguish what is established by
the evidence from what remains assumed. If you revise or withdraw the claim,
write the resulting claim text (or an explicit withdrawal) in full.

EVIDENCE UPDATE:
Evidence update (treat as given for this exercise): After a limited pilot,
p95 latency for requests with offset > 50_000 is 12× the p95 of the first
page under the default sort. Two bulk jobs produced partially duplicated
exports during concurrent catalog writes. Interactive web traffic remains
fast on the first three pages. No cursor implementation has shipped yet.
